description: Aménagements cyclables des Pyrénées Atlantiques is a dataset listed in Data64 open data portal, an open data portal (Opendatasoft) of a region, department, metropolitan area or agency, published or maintained by Département des Pyrénées-Atlantiques. Cette base de données contient l’ensemble des aménagements cyclables de France métropolitaine numérisés dans OpenStreetMap et traités par Geovelo afin de les restituer selon le schéma national des aménagements cyclables. Cette base est filtrée sur les aménagements présent dans le département des Pyrénées atlantiques Sera utilisée dans la page Mobilité durable. Coverage: Pyrénées-Atlantiques. The portal files it under Transports, Déplacements. Its keywords are vélo, aménagement, piste, cyclables, deplacement, vivre dans le 64. The portal shows 3,764 records. It carries geographic features and can be exported as GeoJSON, KML or Shapefile. The portal shows 2023-12-19 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Licence Ouverte v2.0 (Etalab). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support cycling and walking network and demand studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ods-data-le64-fr-portal.
